name: colorcombinations
description: The Dictionary of Color Combinations — historically-grounded color palettes inspired by Sanzo Wada's 1933 Japanese color dictionary.

scripts.build: astro check && astro build && node scripts/make-worker.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN="${CF_PAGES_TOKEN:?CF_PAGES_TOKEN required for a Pages deploy}" npx wrangler pages deploy dist --branch main --commit-dirty=true --project-name=colorcombinations && npm run indexnow
